rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Page 2 of the Official Gazette special extra issue No. 99 (号外特第99号), dated Wednesday 16 September 2020, closes the day's 内閣 appointments with (以上九月十六日) and, under ○内閣総理大臣及び国務大臣退官, states that on the 16th of that month 菅義偉 was appointed Prime Minister (本月十六日内閣総理大臣に菅義偉が任命せられ).

locator.section: ○内閣総理大臣及び国務大臣退官
locator.item: 本月十六日内閣総理大臣に菅義偉が任命せられ

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The same notice states that, 菅義偉 having been appointed on the 16th of that month (本月十六日), 安倍晋三, Prime Minister of the fourth Abe cabinet (第四次安倍内閣の内閣総理大臣安倍晋三), and the ministers of state each lost their office (それぞれその地位を失った).

locator.section: ○内閣総理大臣及び国務大臣退官
locator.item: 第四次安倍内閣の内閣総理大臣安倍晋三…それぞれその地位を失った

A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this role: an unnamed statement or schedule row, a House of Councillors designee who never held the office, or a designation of acting ministers. Ministers, deputy prime ministers and party offices are excluded.
